title: Faith
message: Faith isn't a feeling you have to work up — it's a trust you place in Someone trustworthy. "As many as received Him, to them He gave the right to become children of God, to those who believe in His name." You don't need to have it all figured out. You just need to receive Him and keep leaning your weight on Him, the way you'd lean on a chair without needing to understand its engineering first. Faith grows the more you use it, not the more you analyze it.
explore: Trust, surrender, belief, dependence and following.
reflect: What makes it difficult for you to trust God?
pray: Jesus, I believe; help my unbelief. Teach me to trust You with my whole life.
